data.action: 在雨夜狭巷中持剑半出鞘踏步向前，眼神凌厉威严，风衣下摆飞扬
data.description: 【德克萨斯 · 狭巷对峙与冷冽锋芒】叙拉古阴雨绵绵的古老石砌窄巷深处，昏暗的壁灯在湿滑石墙上投下斑驳的光斑。德克萨斯踏着水洼向前一步，指间刺剑瞬间出鞘半寸，金色的剑芒刺破雨雾，冷冽的杀气让阴影中的杀手们不寒而栗——「不要再跟过来了。我不想让家族的血，再次弄脏这条街道。」
data.lighting: 复古壁灯暖黄局部照明与冷色雨丝漫射
data.location: 叙拉古古城雨夜石砌窄巷
data.promptProse: In a rain-glistened cobblestone alleyway of ancient Siracusa at dead of night, Texas steps forward with deliberate, lethal grace. Her tailored black mafia overcoat flares slightly in the damp wind as she partially unsheathes her golden rapier, the blade catching amber streetlight and casting sharp golden glints through the falling rain. Deep shadows flank the weathered stone arches around her as her Lupo ears pin back in acute combat readiness. An intensely dramatic low-angle cowboy shot delivers peerless cinematic tension, wet surface reflections, and pristine anime key visual perfection.
data.title: 德克萨斯 · 狭巷对峙与冷冽锋芒
